name: SVC_WO_SCHEDULER_FILTERS
description: Table used to store the scheduler filters information.

columns.name: SCHEDULER_FILTER_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for the SVC_WO_SCHEDULER_FILTERS table.

columns.name: SCHEDULER_FILTER_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the filter type for a scheduler based on ORA_SVC_WO_SCHEDULER_FILTER_CD lookup type. A possible value could be ORA_SVC_WO_FITNESS, ORA_SVC_WO_CUSTOM.

columns.name: SCHEDULER_CD
columns.description: The foreign key referencing the SCHEDULER_CD in the SVC_WO_SCHEDULERS_B table.

columns.name: WO_FIELD
columns.description: Property that stores the work order field name on which the filter is to be applied.

columns.name: WO_FIELD_VALUE
columns.description: Property that stores the work order field value.

columns.name: WO_FIELD_TYPE
columns.description: Property that stores the work order field type.

columns.name: FS_RESOURCE_FIELD
columns.description: Property that indicates the field service resource field name from OFS.

columns.name: FILTER_ORDER
columns.description: The order in which the scheduler filter should be applied.

columns.name: ALLOW_RELEASE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether the agent can release filter from the scheduler results.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
